name: Divorce
overview: Scripture establishes marriage as a sacred union where a man leaves his parents and cleaves to his wife, becoming one flesh, as stated in Genesis 2:24. The laws in Exodus 21 address the responsibilities and protections within marital and betrothal relationships, emphasizing the husband's duty to care for his wife and the conditions under which she may be released from the marriage bond. These verses highlight the seriousness of marriage commitments and the provision for release when those commitments are not honored, underscoring the biblical framework for understanding divorce within the context of covenant faithfulness.
